candidates.name: Frontotemporal dementia
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of progressive dysarthria, dysphagia, and cognitive impairment are consistent with frontotemporal dementia.

candidates.name: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
support_spans: Large-amplitude, long-duration motor unit potential in frontalis, mentalis, orbicularis oculi, and genioglossus muscles
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of tongue atrophy, pyramidal signs, and abnormal EMG findings are consistent with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

candidates.name: Frontotemporal lobar degeneration with TBK1 mutation
support_spans: Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene (p.E643del) identified by whole-exon sequencing
candidates.why: The patient's genetic testing revealed a pathogenic variant of the TBK1 gene, which is associated with frontotemporal lobar degeneration.

candidates.name: Progressive supranuclear palsy
support_spans: Severe loss of dopamine transporter binding in basal ganglia
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of vertical gaze palsy and severe loss of dopamine transporter binding in basal ganglia are consistent with progressive supranuclear palsy.

candidates.name: Multiple system atrophy
support_spans: Severe loss of dopamine transporter binding in basal ganglia
Almost total loss in caudate nucleus
candidates.why: The patient's 11C-CFT PET imaging showed severe loss of dopamine transporter binding in basal ganglia, which is consistent with multiple system atrophy.
